description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function that generates human-readable relative time differences (e.g., '31 seconds ago', '54 days ago') based on a given UTC datetime. It utilizes the Carbon library for date calculations.

methods.name: smarty_function_diff_for_humans
methods.description: Generates a human-readable relative time difference (e.g., '3 days ago') based on a UTC datetime parameter using Carbon library.
